description: This Java class defines the 'ConciergeService', a final class extending 'DittoService'. It configures and starts the Eclipse Ditto Concierge service, including setting up the main actor props and specific configuration.

classes.name: ConciergeService
classes.description: Defines the main service class for the Eclipse Ditto Concierge, responsible for configuration and startup logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to start the Concierge service; creates an instance and waits for termination.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Overrides method to provide specific configuration for the Concierge service based on provided scoped configuration.

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Overrides method to provide the actor properties for the main root actor of the service.
